lines.text: Ads interrupt. Influencers cost a fortune. And everyone else posts for free.
NOD puts real products into the posts people were already going to share, and pays them for every verified view.
Verify with Bank I D. Pick a campaign. Upload the photo you were about to post. NOD places the product. You approve it, and publish it yourself.
Views are verified. Disclosure is checked. And the money lands in your wallet.
For brands: upload a product once, set a budget, and NOD distributes it into hundreds of real posts. Change the creative any time. Placements that haven't been approved yet re-render instantly.
Bank I D verified people. Always disclosed. Paid only on verified views. And NOD never posts on anyone's behalf.
NOD. Post as usual. Get paid.
